title: Mushroom Clipart, 12 Mushroom Designs PNG and SVG, Fly Agaric, Morel, Chanterelle, Toadstool, Cottagecore Sublimation Designs
description:
Twelve mushroom clipart designs: a fly agaric, a morel, a chanterelle cluster, a porcini, an oyster mushroom cluster, a puffball, an amethyst deceiver trio, a turkey tail bracket, a mushroom with ferns, red toadstools with oak leaves and acorns, a honey fungus cluster and a parasol mushroom. Each one comes as a full-color PNG with a transparent background at 300 dpi, plus a one-color SVG line-art version of the same design.

Use them for tees and sweatshirts, sublimation mugs and tumblers, tote bags, cards, invitations, stickers, scrapbooks, journals and cottagecore crafts, all year round. The designs are drawn in a cozy flat style with clean dark outlines, so they stay crisp on light and dark backgrounds.

THE 12 DESIGNS
1 Fly agaric toadstool · 2 Morel · 3 Chanterelle cluster · 4 Porcini · 5 Oyster mushroom cluster · 6 Puffball · 7 Amethyst deceiver trio · 8 Turkey tail bracket · 9 Mushroom with ferns · 10 Toadstools with oak leaves · 11 Honey fungus cluster · 12 Parasol mushroom

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 12 PNG files, transparent background, 300 dpi, 3600 px on the longest side (12 in), ready for sublimation, print and print-then-cut
• 12 SVG files: the same designs as single-layer, one-color line art that scales to any size
• One ZIP download with a README and the license

GOOD TO KNOW
• The SVGs are line-art versions for one-color printing, recoloring and crafts, not vinyl cut files: some lines are fine
• There is no text on the designs
• All designs are original, decorative illustrations, not mushroom identification pictures
• Listing photos include digital mockups; you receive the digital files shown.
• Colors vary a little between screens, printers and blanks

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on physical items you make and sell (tees, mugs, tumblers, totes, cards, stickers), up to 500 items per design. Please don't resell, share or upload the digital files, use them on print-on-demand marketplaces, or include them in other digital products.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. The files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
